title: Hardware Key Provider & SecretStore Adapter Terraform module for Private VPCs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that acts as an adapter between hardware-backed key providers (PKCS#11 HSMs and cloud-hosted KMS variants) and Redwood's SecretStore patterns (HashiCorp Vault and cloud Secrets Manager). The module must: (1) provision and register a hardware key provider abstraction, (2) produce secrets artifacts consumable by the Private deployment control plane, (3) include health-checking/monitoring probes and drift detection hooks, and (4) provide a documented upgrade path for KMS/HSM firmware or provider SDK changes without requiring full cluster redeploys. Target providers: AWS KMS + CloudHSM, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault HSM, on-prem PKCS#11 HSM appliances. Deliverables: module code, example consumption manifests for Private control plane, acceptance tests, upgrade playbook, and a 1-hour runbook for SREs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Terraform module exposes stable inputs for key aliasing, provider type, region/endpoint, and Vault/SecretsManager targets. 2) Module creates registration artifacts (signed CSR/provisioning token or Terraform outputs) that the Private control plane can consume. 3) Healthchecks: a lightweight TCP/PKCS11 probe and an authenticated KMS round-trip test are deployed and emit metrics. 4) Automated drift detection alerts in console when key provider config diverges. 5) Upgrade tested: rotate HSM client library and perform zero-downtime provider swap in a canary Private cluster.
